section.title: Edit Models
section.p: pmMDA UML models can be edited either using the provided user interface or more conveniently UML modeling tools such as ArgoUML or Poseidon.

MDA approaches require more formal UML models to allow model transformations and source code artifacts generation. Here we provide some hints which conventions should be followed in UML models transformed with pmMDA.

The naming conventions should follow best practices of UML. Class and interface names starts with uppercase. Property names always start with lowercase. All names should be legal identifiers in the target programming language. The validator framework checks the corectness of identifiers, uppercase and lowercase.
The name of all UML entities should be formulated in English. The pmMDA engine currently only support grammar rules for English language.
The name of properties should be singular if their cardinality is limited to one and plural if multiple instances are possible.

All relashionships should be named. All relationships should be directed. Role names can be defined but are not currently used in the transformation. The validator framework checks that all relationships are named.
